observation: Measurement-artifact loop: designer's first plan measured 3780 errors (TS7031=3153) using tsc --noEmit on a dist-free tree; spec and gate truth is 758. Architecture critique proved it empirically; plan had to be fully revised (2 critique rounds, plan revision commit, zod-amendment commit) before builder started. Root cause: no pre-measurement dist-check. Single prevention: ls packages/shared/dist before measuring; build leaves if absent.

Zod version mis-location: designer and reviewer anchored fixes on root package.json zod (3.25.76); server resolves its own node_modules/zod@4.4.3. Caused a builder BLOCKER on z.record arity (v4 two-arg form) + a plan amendment round. Fix: always resolve packages/<pkg>/node_modules/<dep>/package.json for version-sensitive schema fixes in monorepos with hoisting exceptions.

tsc -b src-dropping trap: building leaf dist via tsc -b scattered ~114 generated .d.ts/.js/.map files into packages/shared/src and packages/db/src; biome flagged 714 noBannedTypes errors on them. Builder raised blocker. Orchestrator diagnosed false; builder's initial lore recorded wrong conclusion (gate needs no leaf dist); orchestrator empirically disproved it (rm dist -> 3428 errors) and corrected lore. Cost: ~3 agent rounds.

SYSTEMIC: The AF1 typecheck gate (tsc --noEmit -p per package, no ref pre-build) is build-state-nondeterministic. CI validates HMAC attestation only — never re-runs the gate. A red local gate (dist-absent) ships green CI. This burned AF2 (Z8-166 attestation-bypass), AF3 (stale-dist drove wrong plan), AF4 (3780 phantom baseline, builder blocker, lore correction round). Every non-leaf drain (AF5 web) will hit it again. Recorded as Z8-169. Needs AF1 follow-up: build leaf dist before gate fan-out.

Stale-base drift (CC-017): AF3 PR #245 merged mid-flight and rewrote tool-registry.ts + assistant-tools.ts (same files AF4 was fixing). Merge auto-resolved cleanly. typecheck-debt.json stored inflated count (3780) needed manual reconciliation; Z8 numbering needed cross-check. Earlier rebase had low marginal value — file overlap was unavoidable, auto-resolve was clean. Genuine CC-017 occurrence.

Architecture critique round 2 was decisive: round-1 critique empirically disproved the 3780 phantom by building leaves and measuring (758, TS7031=0). This saved the builder from chasing 3148 phantom annotations. Without the critique, the entire §3 'make-or-break fixture-type fix' section (phantom work) would have been executed. Multi-phase review protected this workpackage.

AF2 binding policy carried cleanly: no any/@ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error at route boundaries, no noUncheckedIndexedAccess relaxation, !/toBeDefined() only in tests. AC2 grep gate confirmed zero violations across 655 test fixes and 103 src fixes. Policy transmission AF2→AF3→AF4 stable.

ValidatedJson<T> boundary helper is a genuine type-soundness improvement: c.req.valid('json') now typed z.output<T> instead of unknown. Root-cause src fix (not a cast workaround). validate.route-boundary.test.ts is a durable regression proof. Code review confirmed: only cast is schema as never (schema-arg bridge, not a payload cast).

Lore captured proactively during implementation: tsc-b dropping trap + correct 3-step verify sequence (build leaves, clean src droppings, run verify) documented in plans/AF4/lore.md with exact commands. Future AF5 builder has an executable procedure. Initial wrong lore was corrected empirically before shipping.
